headline: Henry Wazne, Chief Executive Officer of Sofibanque: "Before wanting to grow, we must consolidate what we have"
summary: Sofibanque's net profit rose 33% in 2025 to $39.2 million, according to its chief executive Henry Wazne. He said the bank must consolidate its position before pursuing growth, including corporate banking and the mining value chain.
why: Sofibanque is a bank operating in Côte d'Ivoire, and its lending to corporates and the mining sector reflects the local economy's business activity.
original_headline: Henry Wazne, administrateur-directeur général de Sofibanque : « Avant de vouloir croître, il faut consolider ce que nous avons »
